description: L1 defs. entry10 records project and module identity and an intact checkpoint. input20 records the inventory. domain30 writes domain defs. persistence40 writes ports, tables and adapters. usecases50 plans one operation per selected usecase. controllers60 writes one controller per page. support70 writes the access scope, the authority map, the repository registry, the seed plan and the effect plan. finalize80 checks what was persisted and writes the report. It does not call a model and it does not open a repair cycle. This flow never dispatches materialization, agentChangeBackend or agentChangeFrontend.
principles: Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
A done-anchor unlocks the next step. A draft file never unlocks a phase and is never approval evidence.
Pipeline state for this agent lives at l1/{module}/pipeline/agentDefsL1/pipeline.json in the project captured at invocation. The task record is orchestration, not truth.
The planner file l1/{module}/pipeline/pipeline.json is never written or removed. Read and remove of this agent's files use the same file identity as the write.
A step declared here with implemented false stops the run. pipeline.status becomes awaitingStep naming that step. The task completes without failed. The trace says the step is not implemented.
Project and module identity are part of every file and of the checkpoint. The same module name in another project is a different module.
An intact checkpoint is not rewritten by /resume, by a second /run, or by a duplicate or late hook. Approved step state is monotonic.
Child hooks never create a task and never add steps. They complete with a trace.
One repair per unit. Global repair attempts stop at the declared ceiling. finalize80 does not open another repair cycle.
update-status cleans the interaction with input_output. A future clarification that is still pending must not be cleaned.
User-facing refusals are English. /candidate and /rebuild all are refused. Nothing is deleted and no candidate root is applied.
Deterministic first. prompt.md exists only on usecases50, the step that calls a model for operation steps. The model does not write TypeScript.

invocation.moduleRule: The module token is required and must be lowerCamel. The name is never inferred from prose.
invocation.projectRule: mls.actualProject is captured once at invocation and stored on the task and on the checkpoint. Later hooks do not re-read the global.
invocation.candidateRule: /candidate uses the same spelling as the L1 planner and is refused. A candidate path that contains '..' is refused. No tobe root is applied.
invocation.rebuildAllRule: /rebuild all uses the same spelling as agentNewSolution5 and is refused. Nothing is deleted.
invocation.noHandoff: This flow never dispatches agentCbMaterialize, agentChangeBackend or agentChangeFrontend.

dynamicPlanIds.note: entry10 mints only entry10-done. Fan-out, worker and repair ids are reserved so a later step can mint them without inventing a second spelling. A done-anchor is not dispatched as its step.

resume.intactMeans: The checkpoint parses, schema and flow identity match, project and module match the invocation, and entry10 is approved with its own artifact path. A draft file does not approve a later step.
resume.noop: An intact checkpoint is not rewritten. Bytes of that file and of the planner pipeline stay as they were.

steps.goal: CLI, project and module identity, resume of an intact checkpoint. No LLM. Refuses /candidate, /rebuild all, an insecure path, an unknown flag and a missing module.
Coherent snapshot, source hashes, and the file closure. No .defs.ts. Consumer phases stay locked when a contract or a required source is missing.
Models, lifecycle and referenced invariants for the selected entities. Deterministic. No LLM.
Ports, tables and adapters with one physical name and the domain draft unique keys. Deterministic. No LLM.
One worker per selected usecase. The model plans operation steps. Ids, routes and type sources stay mechanical.
Handlers per page, typed binding and projection. Deterministic. No LLM.
Registry of live adapters, access scope, authority map, a seed plan and an effect plan. Deterministic. No LLM. The seed plan has no rows. Effects name a consumer and do not publish.
Integrity, coverage, stale and the receipt. Reads what was persisted. Does not call a model and does not open a repair cycle.
